title: How to watch Camp Flog Gnaw 2026 festival on Amazon Music, Prime Video, and Twitch
summary: For the fourth consecutive year, Amazon Music will exclusively livestream Tyler, The Creator's sold-out festival for free.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Camp Flog Gnaw 2026 livestreams for free on Amazon Music, Prime Video, and Twitch.


- Tyler, The Creator's sold-out festival features more than 40 artists spanning hip-hop, R&B, rock, and more.


- This marks the fourth consecutive year Amazon Music has exclusively livestreamed the carnival.


---


[Amazon Music](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/amazon-music) is bringing


[Camp Flog Gnaw 2026](https://www.campfloggnaw.com/) to fans around the world by exclusively livestreaming the event for the fourth consecutive year.


Taking place November 14–15, 2026 on the Dodger Stadium grounds in Los Angeles, this will be the 12th annual Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival.


The brainchild of Tyler, The Creator, Camp Flog Gnaw 2026 sold out immediately and features a lineup of more than 40 artists spanning hip-hop, R&B, rock, and beyond.


Here's everything you need to know about how to watch the festival livestream.


## How to watch the Camp Flog Gnaw livestream


Amazon Music will bring Camp Flog Gnaw to fans globally, exclusively livestreaming the carnival on the


[Amazon Music app, Twitch, Prime Video, and Amazon Live](https://music.amazon.com/live/events/LGKOBXXFU0) . No subscription is required.


[What is Amazon Music? Here’s everything you need to know](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-is-amazon-music)


We’re answering all your questions about the Amazon Music streaming service.


Hosts Wayno and Jillian Superstar will take viewers behind the scenes with artist interviews and live coverage from the festival, offering an inside look at the weekend’s performances and festivities.


The livestream will be brought to viewers around the world by Lenovo and Wendy’s.


Fans can also catch the performances through a daily international rebroadcast beginning at 8 a.m. GMT, November 15–16, 2026, giving viewers more ways to experience the festival across time zones.


Ahead of the weekend, fans can get ready for the carnival with the official


[Camp Flog Gnaw playlist](https://music.amazon.com/playlists/B0CLHJH7TH) on Amazon Music, featuring music from this year’s performing artists.


## What is Camp Flog Gnaw?


Tyler, The Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival celebrated its 11th edition in 2025, solidifying the event as one of the premier music festivals globally and one of the most sought-after artist-led festivals on the calendar.


[What is ‘Amazon Music Live’? Here’s everything you need to know.](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/amazon-music-live)


The fifth season of 'Amazon Music Live' hits the road with performances on tour from Noah Kahan, Don Toliver, Lainey Wilson, and Doja Cat.


Produced in collaboration with promoter Goldenvoice, the festival has spotlighted unforgettable performances of many artists’ careers including Childish Gambino, The Hillbillies, SZA, A$AP Rocky, Solange, Doechii, KAYTRANADA, Lil Yachty, GloRilla, Billie Eilish, Erykah Badu, André 3000, Ms. Lauryn Hill, and many others, in addition to Tyler himself.


## What is Amazon Music?


[Amazon Music](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-is-amazon-music) is an immersive audio entertainment service that connects fans, artists, and creators through music, podcasts, and culture. It brings fans closer to what they love, with curated and personalized playlists, artist livestreams, artist merch, and Amazon Exclusive podcasts.


[Prime members](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) get access to more than 100 million songs in shuffle mode, All-Access playlists, plus the largest catalog of ad-free top podcasts, included with their membership.


[Discover your top artists, songs, and more with Insights on Amazon Music](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/amazon-music-insights-listening-stats)


Insights is the new destination for exploring and celebrating your personal listening history—rolling out to customers now.


Customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for full, on-demand access to 100 million songs, as well as millions of songs in HD, Ultra HD, and Spatial audio, and the world’s largest selection of audiobooks from


[Audible](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/audible) .


Anyone can listen to Amazon Music by downloading the free Amazon Music app, or wherever they listen to music, including


[Alexa](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/alexa) -enabled devices.

[Alexa+ redefines music intelligence in the Amazon Music app](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/amazon-music-alexa-plus-gen-ai) .
